Working on duckdb-r

Source: AGENTS.md

This repository is the R package for DuckDB: the R layer that presents a DBI driver and a relational API, the C++ glue in src/ that bridges it to the engine, and a vendored copy of the DuckDB C++ engine in src/duckdb/.

Everything this project documents lives in handbook/, the single source of truth. This page only routes there.

The first five minutes

To Read
get a working environment, cold start contributors/setup/
build in seconds instead of minutes build/fast-paths/
build from source, the way CRAN does build/source-build/
find the build knobs and what they cost build/configuration/
run the suite, or one test file testing/suite/
write R the way this package does, flavor seam included architecture/r-layer/
write C++ glue the way this package does architecture/glue/
operate the vendoring loop operations/vendoring/series-loop/ and .claude/skills/

Everything else

Anything not on this page is in the tree, and walking down from handbook/ is how you find it: internal nodes navigate, leaves explain, and every fact has exactly one leaf that owns it — including the limits, the declined requests, and the reasons (the rules). Start at the root and follow the scope sentences; searching the tree is the slower path.
